turns.prompt_text: Does this kit come with a protocol adapter?
turns.response_html:
Based on the documentation and product descriptions, a protocol adapter is generally not included with the Pentair High Power Wireless Link Kit.

Here's a breakdown of what the search results indicate:

  • Separate Purchase: Several sources explicitly state that the "ScreenLogic Interface Protocol Adapter and Cable" must be "purchased separately."
  • Complete Kits: Some vendors offer a "Complete Kit" which bundles the Wireless Link Kit with the ScreenLogic Interface Kit and Protocol Adapter. If you purchased a complete system, it would be included, but if you bought the wireless link kit on its own, it would not.
  • Integrated Models: There may be some newer Pentair systems or specific models where the protocol adapter is "built-in" to the indoor antenna, but for the standard "High Power Wireless Link Kit," it is sold separately.

The diagram you provided, which shows the connection to a Protocol Adapter, reinforces this. The kit provides the wireless link (the indoor and outdoor transceivers), and you connect it to the existing or separately purchased Protocol Adapter, which in turn connects to your pool's control system.

turns.prompt_text: where can one purchase a protocol adapter
turns.response_html:
You can purchase a Pentair protocol adapter from several sources. The part number for the protocol adapter alone is typically 520500.

Here are the most common places to find one:

  • Authorized Pentair Dealers: Pentair's own website states that products like the protocol adapter are "Available Through Dealer." You can use their "Find a Dealer" tool on their website to locate authorized pool and spa equipment dealers in your area. For instance, in the Ankeny, Iowa area, a dealer like Central Iowa Pool & Spa in Des Moines would be a good place to start.
  • Online Pool and Spa Supply Stores: Many online retailers specializing in pool equipment sell the protocol adapter. These include sites like Leslie's Pool Supplies, Pool Supply Unlimited, and other independent pool supply websites. They often offer the adapter as a standalone product or as part of a complete kit.
  • Online Marketplaces: You can also find new or used protocol adapters on sites like eBay. Be cautious with these, as some may be used or refurbished. One seller even advertises a repair service for broken adapters.

Important Considerations:

  • Part Number: Make sure you are purchasing the correct part number, 520500, which is the Protocol Adapter. Other part numbers you might see, like 522104, refer to a complete bundle that includes the protocol adapter, wireless link, and other components.
  • Warranty: Pentair has a "TradeGrade" warranty policy where products purchased from a physical retail store, pool builder, or service company may receive a longer warranty (1-3 years) compared to "EC" (e-commerce) products, which typically have a one-year parts-only warranty.
  • Complete Kits: If you need both the protocol adapter and the wireless link kit, it may be more cost-effective to purchase a complete bundle, which often has a part number like 522104. This ensures you have all the necessary components for a full installation.
